title: label-write --land: the dogfood battery gate refuses pulls in repos that have no dogfood battery (cloud)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

**Defect.** `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --land` runs `landDogfoodGate` on every pull whose title carries `!` or whose `Clause-②:` line carries a `(narrowing)` arm. It does this whatever the repository. The gate's own premise, in its header, is objectstack's: "a pull that lands without that run is ejected by the queue's dogfood shards". `objectstack-ai/cloud` has no `@objectstack/dogfood` battery, and its merge queue runs no dogfood shard. So for a cloud pull the os-dev report can only say `n/a`, `n/a` fails closed, and the gate cannot be cleared.

**Measured** on 2026-11-20 at 23:44 UTC: `label-write.mjs --issue 4405 --repo objectstack-ai/cloud --comment-file … --land` printed `② REFUSED — --land REFUSED by the dogfood battery gate` with "nothing was written". The pull is objectstack-ai/cloud#4405, `fix(service-cloud): service bearer destination (cloud#4404)`, with body line `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. Its contract review on head `77b74d7fbb` is PASS (cloud#4405 comment 7053452461). The seat does not route around the refusal, so the pull now waits on a hand merge.

**Reach.** Every cloud pull with a narrowing arm or a `!` title. That covers security narrowings such as this one.

**Fix shape (proposal).** Scope the gate to repositories that have a battery: today objectstack only, or better, whichever repos the gate's own list names. In any other repo, print a ✓ line saying "not judged: <repo> has no dogfood battery". The self-test gains two cases: a cloud pull with a `(narrowing)` arm is not judged, and an objectstack pull with the same arm still refuses on an `n/a` battery. The gate must stay fail-closed for objectstack.

Domain: `scripts/pm/**` (PM loop tooling), so `domain:skills`, `tooling`.
